_comment: Spoken narration for the smoke round trip. Keys: intro, outro.pass / outro.fail / outro.n/a / outro, step codes (S1, S2), <step code>.email for an email card. Placeholders: {COUNT} {PASSED} {FAILED}. Never ids, addresses, links, record numbers or tokens.
intro: This is the smoke round trip: the path every release has to pass.
outro.fail: This run failed: {PASSED} of {COUNT} steps passed. The summary names the step that broke.
S1: The user opens the app and lands on the home page.
S2: The user searches, and the results page answers.
